reason: Frontend pre-development checklist and quality gate for React/Pixi UI work.
Realm map renderer must preserve backend projection boundaries, provenance, accessibility, and visible failure handling.
Tiled renderer must keep backend-owned state authoritative and limit new state to UI/load diagnostics.
Tiled .tmj/object-layer data crosses a serialized asset boundary and needs typed/validated handling.
Implementation should reuse the existing RealmIsometricStage lifecycle and avoid duplicate projection logic.
Prior route-2 research identifies pixi-tiledmap and Tiled/isometric map constraints.
Accepted visual readability constraints: avoid blocking center geometry and duplicate-looking labels.
